notes: Third homonym under these consonants: נשא¹ (H5375, "lift") and נשא² (H5377, "delude") already exist in the dataset; this root (H5378, "lend on interest") is added as נשא³ per the ascending-Strong's-number superscript convention.

Gloss collision: nearly identical to the existing נשה² (H5383, glosses "lend", hiphil "act as a creditor") -- a different but semantically twin root (final-heh vs. final-aleph); disambiguating search alias added.
Trimmed hiphil's "act as a creditor; exact payment" to "exact payment" per the tightened compound-gloss standard: both describe the one Ps.89.23 citation ("exact") -- synonyms, not two senses.
